title: Audit secret redaction across APIs logs metrics and audit
description: Trace all sensitive values through authentication, node credentials, tunnel configs, process args, diagnostics, backups, metrics, audit, and release evidence and add regression coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: API responses never return passwords, bearer/session tokens, private keys, connection strings, or encrypted secret material
Logs, events, metrics, audit records, screenshots, and generated evidence redact or omit sensitive values
Process/systemd diagnostics expose safe argv metadata only and never raw secret-bearing command lines
Backup/export behavior is explicitly documented and tested for unintended secret exposure
Automated scans/fixtures detect representative secret values without storing real secrets

steps.details: Create disposable sentinel values and assert they are absent from each output surface; do not use real credentials.

steps.description: Search auth, node APIs, tunnel deploy/action/log/event routes, engine/process/runner, backup, metrics, audit, and scripts for raw object/string exposure.

steps.details: Use existing redaction/select helpers where possible; avoid broad serialization changes and preserve API compatibility.

steps.description: Run focused tests, custom harness, typecheck, lint, and a static scan limited to the changed files/evidence.

technicalNotes: Secret values may exist in user-owned local `.env.local`; never read or copy them. Use synthetic sentinels only.
